# Provenance

OpenTyrian engine: https://github.com/opentyrian/opentyrian

Pinned commit: `ac5d0e71f4245744350c6116ce24f10624da58f8`.
Source archive SHA256: `32b213b23e1e14f0570bbcf429f2d785b3904f7e7fd4d19b0f647c18c77cdc84`.
The upstream source tree is retained as ordinary files under `vendor/upstream`.
Engine code is GPL-2.0-or-later; original notices and `COPYING` remain intact.
The offline OPL synthesizer retains its LGPL-2.1-or-later notices in `src/opl.*`.
`port/nortsong.c` is a derivative of upstream `src/nortsong.c` with timing code
retained and sound loading delegated to preconverted resources.
`port/font.c` and `port/fonthand.c` retain upstream renderers and notices, with
translation-aware rendering and width hooks generated by `tools/prepare_ui.py`.

The Chinese bitmap font data is derived from Noto Sans CJK SC 2.004, under
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see `vendor/licenses/Noto-OFL.txt`). Source font:
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/Sans2.004/Sans/OTF/SimplifiedChinese/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf

Source font SHA256: `2c76254f6fc379fddfce0a7e84fb5385bb135d3e399294f6eeb6680d0365b74b`.
Only the generated 169-glyph bitmap subset is retained in the application;
its data license is identified separately in `port/include/zh_data.h`.

Original Tyrian 2.1 freeware data: https://camanis.net/tyrian/tyrian21.zip

Data archive SHA256: `7790d09a2a3addcd33c66ef063d5900eb81cc9c342f4807eb8356364dd1d9277`.
See upstream `doc/tyrian-freeware-license.txt` and the retained data documentation.
The data, converted audio and original game icon retain their original terms;
the repository GPL license does not relicense them. Generated SD resources and
download archives are ignored by Git. No original DOS executable is used by the port.

Pinned build dependencies are listed with URLs and SHA256 in `tools/prepare.py`:

- WASI SDK 24 sysroot / wasi-libc, MIT/Apache-2.0 components and supplied notices.
- LLVM compiler-rt WASM builtins, Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception and supplied notices.
- SDL 2.32.10 declaration headers, zlib license; SDL implementations are not linked into the APP.
- Binaryen 133, Apache-2.0, used as an offline build tool.
- Native offline audio rendering uses local SDL2 declarations and ffmpeg/libmp3lame;
  these tools are not embedded into the WASM application.

Dependency license texts are retained under `vendor/licenses`. The WASI SDK 24
source pins wasi-libc `b9ef79d7dbd47c6c5bafdae760823467c2f60b70` and LLVM
`26a1d6601d727a96f4301d0d8647b5a42760ae0c`; the compiler-rt notice is taken
from that exact LLVM revision.

The final WASM statically links the selected WASI libc and compiler builtins;
its WASI operations are implemented by `port/wasi_adapter.c`, and no WASI Host
imports remain. Corresponding dependency sources are available from the pinned
WASI SDK release and its submodules. Preserve the applicable notices on distribution.
